items.t: Turbo oil feed line can leak and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Replace left turbo oil feed pipe and hose
items.note: Free under recall SC300. Check your VIN.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump can stick and cut power (recall)
items.job: Engine software update; replace high-pressure fuel pump if needed
items.note: Free under recall SC281. Out of recall, a high-pressure pump on the 3.3L can cost $1,500 or more at a shop.

items.t: Engine bay fire risk near the ABS unit (recall)
items.job: Install fuse kit in the engine bay junction box

items.t: Front wiring harness can rub through and short (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front wiring harness, add cover

items.t: Oil pressure switch leaks oil into the wiring harness
items.job: Replace oil pressure switch (and oil-soaked sub harness if needed)
items.note: Low end is the switch alone. One owner paid about $3,500 when the wiring harness had to be replaced too.

items.t: Engine misfire from spark plugs or ignition coils
items.job: Replace spark plugs (set of 6) and any failed ignition coil
items.note: A single coil alone costs much less. Plugs on the V6 sit under the intake on one side, which adds labor.

items.t: Brake pedal vibration from warped front rotors
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors
items.note: Brembo-equipped GT models cost more for rotors and pads.

items.t: Brake vacuum pump can be damaged on cold starts
items.job: Replace brake vacuum pump rotor and vane
items.note: Free under Kia campaign SC204 for eligible VINs.

items.t: Hesitation and check engine light on the 2.0 turbo
items.job: Replace engine computer (ECU)
items.note: Kia service action SA352; covered under warranty for eligible VINs.

items.t: Coolant leak at the transmission fluid warmer
items.job: Replace transmission fluid warmer connector and refill coolant
items.note: Kia service action SA333; may still be done free for eligible VINs.

items.t: Slow or harsh shift into gear when stopped
items.job: Transmission software update

items.t: Rattle from the rear hatch
items.job: Adjust liftgate striker

items.t: Touchscreen goes black
items.job: Head unit software update

items.t: Halogen low-beam headlight goes out
items.job: Replace low-beam bulb and repair connector

items.t: Adaptive headlight warning from moisture
items.job: Add headlight moisture absorber and replace bracket
items.note: If the headlight assembly itself has failed, expect much more.

items.t: Radar cruise and collision warning turn off
items.job: Inspect radar mounting and calibrate front radar

items.t: Sunroof won't fully open or close
items.job: Replace sunroof rear slide assembly

items.t: Fuel gauge doesn't read correctly
items.job: Replace fuel level sender

items.t: Gasoline smell in the cabin
items.job: Fuel and evaporative system leak inspection (smoke test)
items.note: Repair cost depends on which line or valve is leaking.

items.t: Heater hose clamp may be the wrong size
items.job: Replace heater hose clamp and top off coolant
items.note: Kia service action SA479; done free for eligible VINs.

items.t: Front door pull handle comes loose
items.job: Repair front door trim grip handle
items.note: Kia service action SA483 for eligible VINs.

items.t: Remote start doesn't work
items.job: Replace shift lever detent damper

items.t: Touchscreen freezes or radio won't respond
items.job: Head unit software update

items.t: Rattle from the headliner or sunroof area
items.job: Apply anti-noise tape to headliner

items.t: AWD warning or binding from mismatched tires
items.job: Replace mismatched tires (pair)
items.note: Cost depends on tire size; GT models use wider performance tires.
